title: Treatment with Biaoxu Ganmao Granules ameliorates cyclophosphamide-induced immunosuppression in mice: Paeoniflorin-associated modulation of the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Li, Chenxi; Shao, Ping; Hou, Fengzhi; Yu, Nenggao; Liu, Xiaofeng; Cui, Changsheng; Yang, Liang; Han, Ling; Li, Yanchun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药颗粒对免疫抑制小鼠的调节作用，涉及TLR4/NF-kB通路和分子对接，但核心是药物免疫药理，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Biaoxu Ganmao Granules (BXGG) is used clinically for wind-cold syndrome; however, its effects on cyclophosphamide (CTX)-induced immunosuppression and the associated pharmacological basis remain incompletely characterized. METHODS: Two mouse cohorts were used to evaluate BXGG and paeoniflorin in a CTX-induced immunosuppression model. Body weight, thymus and spleen indices, splenic histopathology, serum cytokines, and peripheral blood cell counts were assessed. Ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-quadrupole time-of-flight tandem mass spectrometry (UHPLC-QTOF-MS/MS), network pharmacology, and molecular docking were used to characterize BXGG constituents, blood-absorbed constituents, and putative targets. Paeoniflorin was selected as a representative blood-absorbed constituent for preliminary in vivo validation, and proteins related to the toll-like receptor 4/nuclear factor kappa B (TLR4/NF-kappaB) pathway were examined by Western blotting. RESULTS: BXGG partially reversed CTX-associated reductions in body weight, thymus and spleen indices. It also partially restored serum interleukin-2 (IL-2), interleukin-4 (IL-4), and interferon-gamma (IFN-gamma) levels, and white blood cell (WBC), lymphocyte (LYMPH), platelet (PLT), and reticulocyte (RET) counts. Network analysis and docking prioritized paeoniflorin as a candidate immune-regulatory constituent. Paeoniflorin improved several CTX-impaired immune-related outcomes and decreased TLR4 expression and the phosphorylated inhibitor of kappaB alpha/inhibitor of kappaB alpha (p-IkappaBalpha/IkappaBalpha) and phosphorylated NF-kappaB p65/NF-kappaB p65 (p-p65/p65) ratios in spleen tissue. CONCLUSIONS: BXGG ameliorated several CTX-induced immunosuppressive changes in mice. Paeoniflorin, selected as a representative absorbed constituent, partially reproduced the immunoprotective phenotype and was associated with attenuation of TLR4/NF-kappaB activation. The contributions and potential synergy of other absorbed compounds require further investigation.
abstract_zh: 目的：表虚感冒颗粒（BXGG）临床上用于风寒证；然而，其对环磷酰胺（CTX）诱导的免疫抑制的作用及相关药理学基础尚未完全阐明。方法：采用两组小鼠评估BXGG和芍药苷在CTX诱导的免疫抑制模型中的效果。检测体重、胸腺和脾脏指数、脾脏组织病理学、血清细胞因子和外周血细胞计数。采用超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间串联质谱（UHPLC-QTOF-MS/MS）、网络药理学和分子对接表征BXGG成分、血中吸收成分及推定靶点。选择芍药苷作为代表性血中吸收成分进行初步体内验证，并通过蛋白质印迹法检测与toll样受体4/核因子kappa B（TLR4/NF-kappaB）通路相关的蛋白。结果：BXGG部分逆转了CTX相关的体重、胸腺和脾脏指数降低。它还部分恢复了血清白细胞介素-2（IL-2）、白细胞介素-4（IL-4）和干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）水平，以及白细胞（WBC）、淋巴细胞（LYMPH）、血小板（PLT）和网织红细胞（RET）计数。网络分析和对接将芍药苷优先列为候选免疫调节成分。芍药苷改善了多项CTX损伤的免疫相关结局，并降低了脾脏组织中TLR4表达及磷酸化kappaB抑制剂α/kappaB抑制剂α（p-IkappaBalpha/IkappaBalpha）和磷酸化NF-kappaB p65/NF-kappaB p65（p-p65/p65）比值。结论：BXGG改善了小鼠中多项CTX诱导的免疫抑制变化。芍药苷作为代表性吸收成分，部分重现了免疫保护表型，并与TLR4/NF-kappaB激活的减弱相关。其他吸收化合物的贡献及潜在协同作用需进一步研究。
